title: Farmyard Hello ABC
hook: Morning wakes in sound from A to Z!
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one clear beat after each letter cue
visualStyle: sunny 3D farm storybook, red barn and green field palette, rounded friendly forms, clean isolated foregrounds

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child at the farm gate listening as the morning wakes one sound and object at a time
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: soundscape reset built from cluck, hoofbeat and waking motion
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: warm porch 4/4 with lightly swung hoofbeat pockets
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written morning soundscape; each target earns one concrete sound, motion, texture or job, with internal rhyme/consonance only where it belongs naturally
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: morning sound cue -> recall beat -> target -> safe object-specific gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. fiddle or woodblock answers after the target, with a warm porch pulse
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: fiddle or woodblock answers after the target, with a warm porch pulse
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make a farm feel as if it wakes sound by sound: latch, hoof, cluck, pour, wheel and crow become the child's path into the alphabet.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A close morning listener stands near the gate and barn, naming each farm word through sound, motion and small workday details rather than generic farm praise.
semanticArc: animals and feed wake the yard
chores and farm tools put the day in motion
the full farm soundscape settles again
forbiddenGenericLanguage: farm words for you and me
